name: io.github.GeiserX/lynxprompt-mcp
title: LynxPrompt
description: Search, read and manage AI agent instruction blueprints (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md) on LynxPrompt

environmentVariables.name: LYNXPROMPT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: LynxPrompt API token (lp_...), created under Settings > API tokens. Needed for everything except search_blueprints.

environmentVariables.name: LYNXPROMPT_URL
environmentVariables.description: LynxPrompt instance URL; https:// unless the host is loopback.

environmentVariables.name: LYNXPROMPT_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to register only the read tools (no create, update or delete).
